scope: Real isolated PostgreSQL, explicit inventory and chain fixtures. No actual Minecraft or public-chain payment proof.

checks.name: exact inventory and finite token debit; original operation replay has zero extra effects
owner and immutable item/count bindings reject a different player or changed sale
insufficient items cancel and release holds; missing gas/funds fail before item removal
lost payout reply reconciles the original transfer without another removal or payment
unconfirmed payouts retain finite treasury reservations and prevent oversubscribed item removal
